acceptance: Provisional distinct illustrated candidates only. Stable IDs house/house_w and game semantics unchanged. Fullmaps/nativecoverage/fractionalzoom/runtime/release acceptance remain open.
limitations: Winter02 reduces cyan contamination; tiny native-alpha-edge flecks remain as minor source-only caveat. No discernible halo in reviewed runtime outputs.
Compact hamlet's local turf is intentionally retained. Larger shared-ground repetition/forest scale/full-map readability need review.
profile: compound-v1: pre-allocation resource budget <=4,000,000 conservative full-support axis taps: (scene_width_4x+scene_height_4x) * (ceil(6*max(1,1/(4*uniform_scale)))+1), including out-of-source normalization work; <=32,000,000 retained weight bytes plus <=32,000,000 temporary kernel bytes; reject before weights allocate. Uniform whole-source pixel-edge affine to full 4x scene; transparent extension; separable antialiased premultiplied byte-RGB Lanczos3, signed lobes, source-space radius widened by reduction, output-only rounding and existing alpha/color clamp policy. Outer union boundary formed by reciprocal edge cancellation; reject any sampled alpha >=250 at signed distance <=8 world pixels before guard; alpha zero through 4 world pixels then smoothstep 4..8. Guard full unmasked 4x artwork, then existing resizeLanczos to whole-scene 2x. Ground independently exported by exportConnectionTiles with fixed geometry and grass only, PNG decoded and assembled at exact tile origins; never sampled at scene origin. Compose artwork globally over actual ground PNG assembly, mask union only at final pixels; crop without filtering, final complementary top-left half-open ownership. Decode tile PNG bytes and reassemble ordinary image.Draw Over. Both runtime line parities use actual PNGs, ground first, compound second. Pixel-aligned 2x/4x only; no runtime/whole-map/user acceptance claim.
